name: GPU Parametric Octree Traversal
aliases: GPU Ray Tracing for Visibility Computation
Ray-Traced Soft Shadows using Hierarchical Voxelization
definition: A visibility test to compute physically plausible soft shadows by shooting rays from fragments to light source samples through an octree-like space-partitioning data structure, checking if rays intersect a voxel set to 1.
summary: GPU Parametric Octree Traversal computes soft shadows by traversing an octree via a mipmap hierarchy, prioritizing arithmetic over memory access to efficiently skip empty regions.
